name: agentic-eclipse-library
description: Seven Agent Skills: a first-steps guide that walks a newcomer from their own eclipse photos to a layered Photoshop project with the most useful corona filters, and skills for processing total-solar-eclipse RAW frames into a faithful HDR image of the corona (calibration and stacking, post-processing with detail filters, root-cause artefact repair — in Catalan), for making structure images, unrolled views and coronal-motion animations with the runnable `ael` package, and for checking an image against coronagraphs (K-Cor, SOHO/LASCO, SDO/AIA) in structure and in mean solar brightness (in English); and a skill contributed by Raúl Hussein that takes a whole case to an editable master the photographer accepts (in English). From the 12 August 2026 eclipse project by Pere Guerra.
